text: ポケモン　いっぱいで　もてないな

structure.jp: ポケモン　いっぱいで

patterns.name: 〜で (reason)
patterns.explanation: で here gives the reason for what follows, like 'and so'. いっぱいで = 'being full, so'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing もつ to もてる adds 'can', and ない makes it 'cannot'. もてない = 'can't carry'.

patterns.name: 〜な (musing)
patterns.explanation: な at the end is the speaker remarking on something, like a soft 'huh'. もてないな = 'you can't carry it, huh'.
